(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: MDS/LD/08/02/29 II. Reference No. of Ministry of Land : 4-3/13/2019/AG/144.

I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land/servitude for a public purpose mentioned in the following schedule. The particulars of the land/servitude intend to acquire: The allotments of the land 01 and 02 depicted in the Cadastral map No. 530378 prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kalutara situated in the Village of Bellapitiya of Elawella Grama Niladhari Division No. 650 E in the Divisional Secretary's Division, Madurawala in the District of Kalutara, Western Province. 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land and Particulars : Road; Claimant : Government; Original Claimant : Kotagala Plantation Limited; Extent : 0.2860 Hectare

02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land : Kekunagahahena alias Sorana Estate; Particulars : Garden; Claimant : Government; Original Claimant : Kotagala Plantation Limited; Extent : 9.5090 Hectares All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude claims rights or other relationships, are hereby required to appear personally or by agents dully authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Madurawala on the 12. 02.2025 at 10.00 a.m. Further all persons are hereby requested to inform me in writing with two copies on or before 05.02.2025, the nature of their interest in the land or servitude, the particulars of their claims for the compensation of the said land/lands and the method of the calculation of such amount. B. A. Sithari Udayangani, Divisional Secretary, Madurawala. Divisional Secretariat Madurawala, 22nd day of January, 2025.
